statement.zh: Shaw 牛津通史目录将 Naqada 列为约公元前 4000–3200 年，国家出现列为约公元前 3200–2686 年，古王国列为约公元前 2686–2160 年（Malek 章；绝对年在不同作者间不完全一致）。
statement.en: Shaw’s Oxford handbook TOC lists Naqada as c. 4000–3200 BC, state emergence as c. 3200–2686 BC, and Old Kingdom as c. 2686–2160 BC (Malek); absolute dates disagree across authors.

editorial.notes: Statements paraphrased from cited sections of civ-ancient-egypt.md only.
